allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "PORT 3000 BUSY - PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)" } else { "PORT 3000 FREE" })
PowerShell($cmd = Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { "vercel CLI: $\($cmd.Source\)"; vercel --version } else { "vercel CLI NOT INSTALLED" })

PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "dev server STILL RUNNING - PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)" } else { "port 3000 free - dev server not running" })

PowerShell($dirs = @\('src','public'\); $files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Path $dirs | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' }; $count = \($files | Measure-Object\).Count; $size = [math]::Round\(\($files | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1KB\); "src+public: $count files, ${size} KB total"; Get-ChildItem -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\(package|tsconfig|next\\.config|postcss|eslint|\\.env\\.example|vercel\)' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
